purpose: First fresh-repo, real-provider, human-reviewable Product validation for Release 2.0. Set A of the contamination rule: if any Product modification is later guided by these scenarios, this set becomes Dev/Diagnostic and PRODUCT-ACCEPT-25 must use a fresh Set B.

product.client_control_of_grounding: NONE (Product policy; request contract stays question/message only)

provider.name: deepseek
provider.token_accounting: input/output tokens not exposed by public Product contract; recorded as UNKNOWN

knowledge_corpus.note: same frozen verified corpus as all prior v7 integration runs; NOT retuned for these fresh repos

fresh_repos.name: vanna
fresh_repos.prior_exposure: none: Product never ran against this repo before this validation

fresh_repos.name: instructor_change
fresh_repos.applied_as: git apply of the pinned change commit's diff as UNCOMMITTED working-tree changes (13 modified files; new test file tests/v2/test_security_regressions.py stays untracked, matching a realistic user state)

run_discipline.timeout_rule: each Product LLM call carries the frozen 20s provider timeout; the runner imposes no extra timeout and never re-sends a request
run_discipline.infra_failure_policy: record the task as INFRA with the observed error and continue with the remaining scenarios; no rerun
run_discipline.analysis_after_all_runs: unified analysis only after the full suite finishes

A1.question: vanna Agent 的 temperature 配置默认值在哪里定义？用户修改 AgentConfig 的 temperature 后，这个值沿着哪些代码路径传递，最终在哪里传给底层 LLM 请求生效？请读取实际源码回答。

A2.question: vanna 的 ToolRegistry 是如何注册和查找工具的？Agent 执行时如何解析并校验模型输出的工具调用？请结合 registry 与工具调用处理源码说明。

A3.question: instructor.from_openai 是怎么把普通 openai 客户端变成结构化输出客户端的？请说明涉及的文件与关键函数，以及默认 Mode 和 patch 核心逻辑的位置。

B.question: 请先解释 RAG 中检索增强 prompt 组装的原理：相似问答、DDL、文档这些检索结果如何注入 prompt 再生成。然后对照说明这个仓库 generate_sql 的实现链路：每一步检索什么、如何拼 prompt、最后谁把 prompt 提交给 LLM？它和通用 RAG 流程有什么差异？

C.question: 我当前工作区有一组未提交的修改。请分析这组修改影响了哪些模块和边界，并推荐我应该重点跑哪些现有测试来验证这次修改。

D.question: vanna 的 HyDE 查询改写模块是在哪里实现的？改写出的假设文档是如何用于相似问题检索的？请指出具体模块和函数。
D.ground_truth_note: pinned vanna has NO HyDE / query-rewriting module (verified by grep at freeze time); acceptable outcomes: justified refusal, or completed answer that explicitly states the module does not exist with real evidence

turns.question: instructor 把 LLM 原始响应转换成结构化对象的核心逻辑在哪里实现？
那这个转换逻辑是谁调用的？它在 create 请求主流程的哪一步？
如果校验失败，重试是怎么接入的？max_retries 如何控制总尝试次数？
README 或 docs 对这个重试/再请求行为的描述和代码实现一致吗？请对照说明。

E.conversation_policy: one server-owned Engineering conversation; server-side history + bounded context window (6 messages / 1200 tokens) as frozen in PRODUCT-CONVERSATION-20

review_contract_per_task.answer_obligation_coverage: coverage of the question's real obligations
